about_the_game:
Step into the hidden world behind every video call, every online purchase, and every streaming service: the data center. In Cloud Server Simulator, you’ll take control of a growing warehouse packed with servers, racks, and networking hardware.

Build clusters of machines to share workloads, manage bottlenecks in your network backbone, and prepare for unexpected traffic spikes. Like real-world operations, demand never stays still. It rises, falls, and shifts in unpredictable patterns. Anticipating these waves is the difference between smooth uptime and costly outages.

Your warehouse is the heart of your operation. As you expand, you’ll organize multiple server groups, experiment with placement strategies, and learn to scale your hardware to match the world’s appetite for cloud computing. Watching the racks fill with new equipment, tuning performance, and knowing you built the backbone of something vast and invisible gives the game its unique rhythm.

Cloud Server Simulator isn’t about flashy explosions or endless micromanagement. It’s about the satisfaction of seeing your digital empire thrive. At the core of the simulation is a Unix-like terminal and file system that gives you direct control over your machines. From installing server software to monitoring resource usage, everything runs through a command-line interface designed to feel authentic and functional.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Design and expand your own data center. Balance CPU load, network demand, and power usage while keeping performance stable. Every server counts in this strategic simulator of the digital backbone of our world.
